Definition: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
BiblicalUsage: 1) period, generation, habitation, dwelling; 1a) period, age, generation (period of time); 1b) generation (those living during a period); 1c) generation (characterised by quality, condition, class of men); 1d) dwelling-place, habitation
